case: PostgreSQL scalar enum XLSX re-import through Gnumeric
contract: The native fixture contains literal NULL, Unicode, markup, the formula-shaped enum label =1+1, and SQL NULL; empty enum text is refused before export and an existing destination stays unchanged.
BookiE writes the formula-shaped label as an XLSX string cell without a formula and SQL NULL as a blank cell.
Gnumeric ssconvert opens source.xlsx, saves gnumeric-roundtrip.ods, then saves gnumeric-roundtrip.xlsx; both retain the exact labels as strings, keep SQL NULL blank, and create no formula.
The checker verifies B2 through B6 in source XLSX, re-saved ODS and XLSX, including literal NULL, Unicode, markup, =1+1 and SQL NULL.

native_export_test.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=<evidence-dir>/source.xlsx cargo test --locked -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_file_export_contract::value_contract_custom_enum_xlsx_file_export_keeps_text_labels_and_refuses_empty_safely -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: Install Gnumeric in the pinned Debian container.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks exact B2:B6 values, string cell types, blank NULL and absence of formulas in source and re-saved workbooks.
consumer_assertions.result: All labels, including =1+1, remain text and SQL NULL remains blank.

remaining: Other spreadsheet applications, enum cell shapes and the broader B3 matrix remain open.
